subject: planner: use TxnCtx.InfoSchema to prevent schema inconsistency (#49947)
summary: Change is a targeted correctness fix: `buildPointUpdatePlan` now fetches InfoSchema via `sessiontxn.GetTxnManager(ctx).GetTxnInfoSchema()` instead of `ctx.GetInfoSchema()`, aligning fast-path UPDATE planning with the TxnManager/Preprocess InfoSchema source and reducing risk of mixing schema snapshots (panic/mis-plan) when session TxnCtx and domain schema diverge. No remaining plausible Blocker/High issues found in planner behavior for this commit.
